hero.subtitle: Every great meal tells a story. We built Table Tap to fade into the background—so nothing stands between your guests and the moments they'll remember forever. Seamless ordering. Effortless service. Pure hospitality.

services.title: Your Restaurant,
services.description: Complete freedom to customize every aspect of your digital presence. Edit menus, launch offers, manage orders from every platform—all in real-time, all from your phone. No developers needed.

items.title: Scan. Order. Enjoy.
items.description: Guests scan a beautiful QR code at their table, browse your visual menu, and order instantly. No downloads required—works on any phone, any browser.

items.title: Menus That Come Alive
items.description: Showcase your dishes with stunning photos, detailed descriptions, and real-time pricing. Update items, mark sold-out, or add specials—changes reflect instantly.

items.title: One Dashboard. All Orders.
items.description: QR orders, Swiggy, Zomato—everything flows into one unified screen. Your kitchen sees all orders in real-time with notification sounds. No more tablet juggling.

items.title: Offers That Drive Sales
items.description: Create happy hour deals, festive discounts, BOGO offers, or combo meals in minutes. Schedule them to go live automatically and watch your revenue grow.

features.title: Total Control.
features.description: You know your restaurant best. Table Tap gives you powerful tools to manage everything—from your menu to your team to your inventory. No tech skills required.

mainFeatures.title: Multi-Restaurant Management
mainFeatures.description: Own multiple locations? Manage all your restaurants from one dashboard. Switch between outlets instantly, view consolidated analytics, and maintain consistency across your brand.

mainFeatures.title: Unified Analytics Dashboard
mainFeatures.description: See the big picture with aggregated insights across all your restaurants. Compare performance, track revenue trends, and identify your best performers—all in one view.

mainFeatures.title: Menu Editor
mainFeatures.description: Add dishes with photos, descriptions, and prices. Organize by categories. Mark items as sold out instantly. Your menu, your way.

mainFeatures.title: Smart Inventory
mainFeatures.description: Track stock levels in real-time. Get alerts when supplies run low. View activity logs for complete transparency.

mainFeatures.title: Staff Management
mainFeatures.description: Add your team with role-based access—Manager, Captain, Chef, Waiter, Cashier. Everyone sees only what they need.

mainFeatures.title: AI Analytics
mainFeatures.description: Understand your business with AI-powered insights. Ask questions in plain English and get instant answers about sales, trends, and more.

mainFeatures.title: QR Code Generator
mainFeatures.description: Generate unique QR codes for each table. Print-ready designs that match your restaurant's style. Easy to replace anytime.

mainFeatures.title: Real-Time Notifications
mainFeatures.description: Instant order alerts with sounds. Browser notifications even when you're away. Never miss an order again.
